en: A hand-colored early-20th‑century postcard showing a quiet residential street lined with substantial multi‑storey houses with red gabled roofs and decorative façades. A fenced front garden and sidewalk run along the street, with a few pedestrians visible. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink. At the bottom, printed captions in German identify the location and publisher, noting the year 1906.
